title: Scalar extension on the bounded derived categories of finite-dimensional vector spaces
statement:
Let $K\subset L$ be a field extension. For a field $F$ let $D(F)$ be the derived category of $F$-vector spaces [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with localization functor $Q$ from cochain complexes, and $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(F)\subset D(F)$ the full subcategory of objects with bounded, finite-dimensional cohomology [def-weil-point-fd-complexes]. The *scalar extension* functor

$$
-\otimes_KL:D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(K)\longrightarrow D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(L)
$$

is defined as follows. The extension of scalars of vector spaces $V\mapsto V\otimes_KL$ [def-weil-vector-space-scalar-extension] is an exact functor $\operatorname{Mod}_K\to\operatorname{Mod}_L$ [lem-weil-field-scalar-extension-exact]; applied termwise to a complex $C=(C^r,d^r)$ it gives the complex $C\otimes_KL$ with terms $C^r\otimes_KL$ and differentials $d^r\otimes_KL$, and it induces a triangulated functor $T_{L/K}:D(K)\to D(L)$ with a natural isomorphism $T_{L/K}(QC)\cong Q(C\otimes_KL)$ [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. Since $\mathrm H^i(C\otimes_KL)\cong\mathrm H^i(C)\otimes_KL$ [lem-weil-cohomology-commutes-scalar-extension], and $V\otimes_KL$ is zero, resp. finite-dimensional, exactly when $V$ is, $T_{L/K}$ carries $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(K)$ into $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(L)$; $-\otimes_KL$ is the restriction of $T_{L/K}$ to these full subcategories. It commutes with shifts and carries distinguished triangles of $D(K)$ with vertices in $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(K)$ to distinguished triangles of $D(L)$. For a tower $K\subset L\subset M$ the isomorphisms $c_{M/L/K}:(-\otimes_KL)\otimes_LM\cong-\otimes_KM$ and $\iota_K:-\otimes_KK\cong\operatorname{id}$, induced by the termwise isomorphisms $(V\otimes_KL)\otimes_LM\cong V\otimes_KM$ and $V\otimes_KK\cong V$ and coherent for towers of four fields, are those of [lem-weil-derived-field-scalar-extension-tower], restricted to $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}$.

Specializations. Fix a prime $\ell$, $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and the directed set $\mathcal E_\ell$ of finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. For $E'\subset L$ in $\mathcal E_\ell$, the functors $-\otimes_{E'}L:D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E')\to D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(L)$ with the isomorphisms $c_{M/L/E'}$ and $\iota_{E'}$ are the transition functors of the directed system $(D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E'))_{E'\in\mathcal E_\ell}$ whose 2-colimit is the stagewise $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$. Taking $L=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ gives $-\otimes_{E'}\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell:D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E')\to D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$, with $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ here the category of [def-weil-point-fd-complexes] for the field $F=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ (not the 2-colimit).

split_report.summary: Restated the definition for an arbitrary field extension K ⊂ L (covering both the finite stages E' ⊂ L of the 2-colimit and L = Q̄_ℓ), with D^b_fd(F) taken from def-weil-point-fd-complexes (the subcategory of D(F) with bounded finite-dimensional cohomology) instead of 'the bounded derived category of finite-dimensional spaces of def-weil-finite-coefficient-point', which now delegates that notion to def-weil-point-fd-complexes. The facts the definition needs are named nodes: exactness of -⊗_K L on vector spaces (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-field-scalar-extension-exact, ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat), the induced triangulated functor on D (lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated, Mathlib leaf Functor.mapDerivedCategory), landing in D^b_fd via cohomology commuting with scalar extension (lem-weil-cohomology-commutes-scalar-extension), and the tower and identity isomorphisms with their coherence (new unsplit node lem-weil-derived-field-scalar-extension-tower; Mathlib has only the termwise/module-level ingredients). Dropped def-weil-finite-coefficient-point and def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension from stmt_deps (the former is a consumer, the latter enters through def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set); the 2-colimit itself (def-weil-point-fd-qlbar-category) is mentioned in words but not cited, since that node defines the colimit using these functors.
